name: Runner Extras - TestPage GoToRecord
brief: Proves TestPage.GoToRecord(Rec) positions the test page on the requested row instead of throwing NullReferenceException inside BC's own NavTestPageBase.ALGoToRecord body.
description: Reproduces the Pageworks TestPage cluster (14 tests). The runner registers a replacement for NavTestPageBase.ALGoToRecord via Hook(...), but Hook() routes into the JmpHook layer, which is DISABLED by default (Cecil-only). ALGoToRecord was never migrated to a Cecil IL rewrite, so the registration was a silent no-op and BC's unpatched body ran instead — NREing on the runner's skeleton state with no runner frame on the stack. RED (before the fix): GoToRecord throws NullReferenceException. GREEN (after the fix, ALGoToRecord migrated to Cecil): GoToRecord positions the page on the requested row and the page's field values match that row. A negative test proves a record that is filtered out is NOT navigated to.
